comment: XPS/Auger line positions (eV) for labelling, extracted from Thermo Avantage's own reference database (QuantLib01, libraries ALTHERMO1 for XPS / AUGQNT for Auger; Al K-alpha). 'be' = binding energy; Auger lines give 'ke' (kinetic energy) instead. rank 1 = the line normally used, higher = weaker/secondary. Edit or extend this file freely.
